# Aspect Ratio Helpers

Use the helpers to maintain consistent ratios across breakpoints.

## Pro-tips

The helpers wrap embedded media. The `<iframe>` tag is the primary
target; authors usually copy a vendor embed snippet and drop it
inside the wrapper. Skip the `frameborder="0"` attribute on your
`<iframe>`s — the helper applies the modern equivalent.

## Live example

The wrapper preserves the aspect ratio of the embedded `<iframe>`:

<Example code={`<div class="ratio ratio-16x9">
  <iframe src="/intro.mp4" allowfullscreen></iframe>
</div>`} />

## Reference snippets

The pattern looks like this in raw HTML:

```html
<div class="ratio ratio-16x9">
  <iframe src="/intro.mp4"></iframe>
</div>
```

That snippet shows an `<iframe>` rendered inside the wrapper.
